sentiment.rationale: The document reports Q2 revenue and EPS beats versus prior guidance (1.5m paid net adds vs. 1.0m forecast), but forward guidance for Q3 paid net adds of 3.5m is only slightly above the prior year period's 2.2m and management explicitly attributes the Q2 beat partly to COVID-related lumpiness. Full-year operating margin target of 20% is reaffirmed, not raised, and management notes that 2021 margin will be 'a little under' the prior year's 18% pace. The overall tone is confident but the forward guidance is essentially in line with prior expectations, not materially raised.

summary.revenue: Revenue increased 19% year over year to $7.3 billion in Q2 2021.
summary.eps: Diluted EPS of $2.97 vs. $1.59 a year ago, including a $63m non-cash unrealized loss from FX remeasurement on Euro denominated debt.
summary.guidance: Q3 2021 forecast: revenue $7,477 million, operating income $1,550 million, diluted EPS $2.55, paid net additions 3.5m. Full-year 2021 operating margin target of 20% reaffirmed. Free cash flow expected to be approximately break even for full year 2021.
summary.margin: Operating margin of 25.2% in Q2 2021, expanded 3 percentage points year over year. Full-year 2021 target of 20% operating margin vs. 18% in 2020.
key_risks: COVID-related production delays in 2020 have led to a lighter first half of 2021 slate that will build through the course of the year.
COVID and its variants make predicting the future hard.
Pandemic has created unusual choppiness in growth and distorts year-over-year comparisons.
Engagement per member household in Q2 2021 was down vs. unprecedented COVID levels, though still up 17% vs. Q2 2019.
key_opportunities: Expansion into games as a new content category, included in members' subscription at no additional cost.
Low-cost mobile-only plan expanded to 78 additional countries across South East Asia and sub-Saharan Africa.
Strong second half slate expected with productions largely running smoothly.
Long runway for growth as streaming represents just 27% of US TV screen time vs. 63% for linear television.
Growing operating profit allows return of capital to shareholders via share repurchases.

management_tone.label: confident
management_tone.justification: Management expresses confidence in the business trajectory, stating 'we are confident that we have a long runway for growth' and 'we're optimistic in our ability to deliver a strong second half slate.'
